data.opportunityTitle: Established Clinician Investigator Award to Support Mentoring (KS1)

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The Established Clinician Investigator Award to Support Mentoring provides support to established clinician investigators for a sustained period of protected time to provide high-quality mentoring to early-career clinician research scientists.
